component.name: VPN Doctor
component.summary: Diagnose, connect and protect your VPN connections

description.p: VPN Doctor is a companion to NetworkManager. It connects the VPNs you already use and explains what goes wrong, where the desktop only says that the activation failed.

ul.li: Explains failures from the NetworkManager reason and the VPN plugin log
Several VPNs at once, each in its own tab with live logs
Detects conflicts between VPNs and with the local network
Diagnoses Remote Desktop servers reached through the VPN
Runs openfortivpn directly when the NetworkManager plugin fails
Keeps secrets in the desktop keyring, never in files

description.p: First packaged release: NetworkManager overlay, tabs, conflict detection, keyring secrets, privileged helper for openfortivpn and custom skins.
